reviews.review_description: I was really looking forward to playing and then, I was really disappointed at how small the so call, open world is. I  have no problem with the low poly world,  but why is it so small? 🤔  all there is a  climb  and a very small area to walk around,  I really don't like leaving bad reviews,  I Usually just don't leave one,  but after playing this people should know this game is only Worth a dollar if that iv played games for free  worth more.  I'm really sorry for a bad review but there's been a lot of false advertising vr games, and this is one of them.  But I didn't ask for a refund for this game. Developers if you make the open world a whole lot bigger, I'll change my review and star rating,  sorry again,  but I was really looking forward to playing this game.

Nothing like what you would expect. No options. No tutorial. Basically a very poorly implemented climbing game with wonky controls. Very easy to accidentally fall out of the world and fall forever. Like a poorly designed Horizons world. Definitely requesting a refund.
